cases.message: What is included in Glaze & Sip?
cases.reply:
Welcome to Petal & Crumb Atelier. 

Our Glaze & Sip experience is a 90-minute pottery-painting seat for USD 38 per person. It includes one ceramic piece to paint, one drink of your choice, and one pastry from our seasonal counter. 

Workshops are usually held Friday through Sunday and require advance reservation to confirm availability. Would you like to reserve a table for this gentle creative pause?

cases.message: How much would that experience cost for four people?
cases.reply:
For four guests, the Glaze & Sip experience totals USD 152 (USD 38 per person), which includes four ceramic pieces, four drinks, and four pastries across your 90-minute studio session. 

If you would like to request a reservation for your group, please share your name, email address, and your preferred date and time, and I will gladly gather those details for our team to confirm.
